# CruiseKit

CruiseKit is a free cruise planning app for iPhone and Android.

CruiseKit helps cruise travelers estimate realistic cruise costs, organize cruise itineraries, visualize cruise routes, and use cruise port guides. Public website pages include a true cost calculator, cruise port guides, cruise planning content, and feature pages for route maps, port guide snapshots, itinerary and port maps, and cruise-day planning.

Important product boundaries:
- CruiseKit map-style features are for planning and destination discovery.
- Port guide snapshot cards are custom visuals and do not require live map tiles.
- The mobile app uses MyDay, Spend, and More tabs; saved-itinerary Ports and manual MyCrew check-ins are under More.
- Map-style app features use saved-itinerary route context and static port-guide snapshots, not a separate Explore tab or live pin-browsing surface.
- CruiseKit does not request location permission for port guide snapshot cards.
- CruiseKit does not sell unsupported offers or hide core launch planning features behind a paywall.

- iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/cruisekit/id6770305548
